sentences.text: THE  PETITIONER ON BAIL IN SPL.S.CNO.
POCSO NO. 10/2023

PENDING ON THE FILE OF ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND  SESSIONS JUDGE FTSC -I AT KOPPAL IN CONNECTION WITH  CRIME NO. 1/2023 REGISTERED IN WOMEN POLICE STATION  KOPPAL FOR THE OFFENCE 363, 343, 376(2) (N) OF IPC AND  SECTION 6 OF POCSO ACT 2012 PENDING TRIAL OF THE CASE.
 -2-  CRL.P No. 100859 of 2023  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner is before this court seeking his enlargement on bail in a petition under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for it having been turned down by the learned Sessions Judge, in terms of the order dated 13.04.2023.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.

3. Facts in brief are as follows:
(a) On 04.01.2023 a second respondent registered a complaint before jurisdictional police that one out of his three children by name Ayisha aged about 16 years 08 months who was studying PUC, at Govt. Girls College has gone missing from 31.12.2022 at about 10.00 p.m. Therefore a crime comes to be registered for offences punishable under Section 363 of IPC, initially against the petitioner on grounds of suspicion.

(b) The police after tracing the victim and conduct of investigation filed a charge sheet against the petitioner for offence punishable under Sections 363, 343, 376 of IPC and Section 2(n) and 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
On registration of the crime i.e. from 10.01.2023 the petitioner is in custody.
After filing of the charge sheet the petitioner knocked at the doors of the learned Sessions Judge seeking grant of bail.
Learned Sessions Judge turns it down, therefore the petitioner is before this Court.
4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner and the daughter of the complainant : victim were in love.
The victim voluntarily came with the petitioner and stayed in darga for 7 days and one of those days he is alleged to have had sexual intercourse with the victim.
The victim after returning back to the home, a crime is registered, therefore he seeks enlargement of bail on the ground that it was a case of love between the victim and the petitioner.

sentences.text: 5. Learned High Court Government Pleader would refute the submissions and object for enlarging the petitioner on bail alleging that the case is of the offence punishable under Section 6 of POCSO Act and the age of the victim is 16 years 08 months, she seeks for dismissal of the petition.
6. I have given my anxious consideration to the submissions made by the respective learned counsel and perused the material on record.
7. The narrated facts are not in dispute.
The petitioner claims to be in love with the victim and the victim also claims to be in love with the petitioner.
They two elope from the house and stay in a dargah for about few days and alleged that the petitioner had physical relationship with the victim.
After victim is traced, gives her statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.

The statement reads as follows:
"zA..A.PA 164 CrAi QAi P.
Az Nz P U N zq QAiiUPA D Egvz.
v  1 Az MjUg wwz. ig 15 U Az  v  eU Uzg zUP Vgv. C ig 2 U P  Ez.
Avg  PP Ag.
s  rPv."
8. On perusal of the statement it would be indicate that the victim voluntarily goes with the petitioner and stayed with the petitioner for a few days.
There is no indication allegation of any sexual intercourse committed by the petitioner on the victim in terms of the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
They have stayed in a darga, therefore there is no allegation.
In the light of the statement of the victim under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. that she on her own volition went with the petitioner.
Looking at the age of the petitioner who is 22 years old and he being in prison for 6 months now, I deem it appropriate to enlarge the petitioner on bail imposing certain conditions.

9. For the aforesaid reason, the following:
ORDER The criminal petition is allowed.

The petitioner shall be released on bail in connection with Crime No.1 of 2023 registered by the Koppal Women Police Station,
Koppal, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioner shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees two lakhs only) with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
(ii) The petitioner shall not indulge in tampering the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) The petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional Court on all future hearing dates unless exempted by the Court for any genuine cause.
